content.title: US Backing Of Argentina 'Very Important': GeoPark CEO
content.description: GeoPark announces investment in Argentina's Vaca Muerta, one of the world's fastest-growing shale regions. Its CEO Felipe Bayon discusses how the transaction reshapes GeoPark's growth trajectory and how an US aid package for Argentina is "very important" to mitigate the impact of the country's shaky finances on its shale industry on "Bloomberg Markets" with Scarlet Fu.
